note: The paragraph 2 chapeau is kept in this passage so that 'shall' stays pointable. The all-hazards approach, and the aim of protecting network and information systems and their physical environment, are that shared parent qualification. They are not ten separate duties. 'At least' means the list is a minimum. This passage does not itself name essential and important entities; the chapeau refers to the measures in paragraph 1. One listed item: policies on risk analysis and information system security. This is minimum content of the paragraph 1 measures, not a second statement of paragraph 1. Discovery hints name plausible artifacts. They are not proof that a measure is appropriate, proportionate, or in place, and they are not proof that a Member State has transposed this duty.

references.law_text:
The measures referred to in paragraph 1 shall be based on an all-hazards
approach that aims to protect network and information systems and the physical
environment of those systems from incidents, and shall include at least the
following: (a) policies on risk analysis and information system security;

remediation_hint: Look for policies that address both risk analysis and information system security.
scope: risk analysis and information system security
